**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity), confidence 0.9.**

- **Responsive clause:** Section 6.1 (p0037) — the only exclusivity obligation binding us. It bars us from any similar internet project for Deerskin Products *or substantially similar products* and hands HDI the exclusive right to use our own "Deerskin" brand for a direct-to-consumer site.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** the restriction runs for the full term, which auto-renews annually under Section 4.1 (so well beyond 12 months), and there is no automatic termination of exclusivity for HDI service-level or delivery-date failures — Section 1.6 is only a one-off launch-delay right, and any other exit triggers the Section 4.2 Termination Payment. Section 6.2's closeout-merchandise carve-out is too narrow to cure it. That is the walk-away pattern.
- **Not flagged:** Section 6.3 (HDI's own restriction) and Section 5.2 (our exclusive editorial control) benefit us and were left untouched; the non-exclusive Marks licence in p0038 is preserved.
- **Redline (preferred, validated ok:true):** single surgical replace of 6.1 with "HDI shall be a non-exclusive provider of the services under this Agreement, and the Company shall have no exclusivity or sole-provider obligation to HDI." The fallback (Deerskin Products only, 12 months, automatic performance-based exit) is offered in the comment.
